title: Feedback-08 complete cargo orientation and owner setup
acceptance_criteria: Resolved oriented geometry drives examination, pickup/revalidation and both outlines; collision, authority, tolerance and production physics are preserved.
Replacement drops preserve contents/ownership and use the admitted actor frame world basis without false membership or new stack state.
Permission-2 yaw/cargo setup uses loaded-only identity checks, one world-Y velocity pulse and the existing five-unit jug grant path; refusals do not mutate state.
Fresh focused JVM/native and full regressions have verified counts and clean shutdown; every genuine failure remains a failure.
manual_steps: After technical readiness, use this worktree's normal development launch and a disposable world. As a permission-2 operator with a live controlled body and loaded clear space, run /ms14 shuttle_fixture build; retain its ship ID.

Enter through the front airlock using normal movement/jumping. Run /ms14 shuttle_fixture cargo <ship-id> aboard: one five-unit water jug should appear near the body without overwriting hands or carrier inventory.

Use configured examine/pickup controls on the jug, then Drop active hand (default Q). Selection/outlines should agree with the oriented physical-profile proxy, and the jug should retain five units and normal ownership. The proxy is not the exact mesh.

Run /ms14 shuttle_fixture yaw <ship-id> 0.4 once; repeat query, pickup and drop as the cabin turns. Replacement drops should use the current actor-frame world basis without loss. This is a rad/s velocity delta, not an angle or piloting. Do not test high-speed impacts or pitch/roll.
